q: When the LORD appeared to young King Solomon in a dream, what did He say?
a: Ask, and I will give it
why: God offered Solomon any gift.
quote: Ask, and I will give it to you!

q: In his dream, how did King Solomon describe himself to God?
why: He felt too young to rule.
quote: But I am only a little child, not knowing how to go out or come in.

q: When God said “Ask,” what did King Solomon ask for?
why: He wanted to judge God's people well.
quote: Therefore give Your servant an understanding heart to judge Your people

q: How did the Lord feel about King Solomon's request for wisdom?
why: Solomon did not ask selfishly.
quote: Now it pleased the Lord that Solomon had made this request.

q: Besides wisdom, what did God also give King Solomon that he did not ask for?
why: God gave more than he asked.
quote: Moreover, I will give you what you did not request—both riches and honor

q: When two women claimed the same baby, what did King Solomon order as a test?
why: The real mother would show herself.
quote: Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other.

q: How did King Solomon know who the baby's real mother was?
why: Her love for the child showed.
quote: Give the living baby to the first woman. By no means should you kill him; she is his mother.

q: What did King Solomon plan to build for the Name of the LORD?
why: God had promised this to David.
quote: So behold, I plan to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God

q: For the temple, what wood did King Solomon order from Lebanon?
why: Lebanon's cedars were famous.
quote: Now therefore, order that cedars of Lebanon be cut down for me.

q: While Solomon's temple was built, what tools were never heard there?
why: Stones were cut at the quarry.
quote: so that no hammer or chisel or any other iron tool was heard in the temple while it was being built.

q: What did King Solomon overlay the whole inside of the temple with?
why: It was a glorious house for God.
quote: So he overlaid with gold the whole interior of the temple

q: How many years did it take King Solomon to build the temple?
why: It was finished in every detail.
quote: So he built the temple in seven years.

q: When Solomon's temple was dedicated, what filled the house of the LORD?
why: God's glory filled it.
quote: the cloud filled the house of the LORD

q: At the temple's dedication, what did King Solomon say cannot contain God?
why: God is greater than any building.
quote: Even heaven, the highest heaven, cannot contain You, much less this temple I have built.

q: What did the prophet Elijah tell King Ahab would not come for years?
why: Only at Elijah's word would it rain.
quote: there will be neither dew nor rain in these years except at my word!

q: By the Brook of Cherith, which birds did God command to feed Elijah?
why: God cared for His prophet.
quote: and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.

q: What did the ravens bring Elijah each morning and evening?
why: He drank from the brook.
quote: The ravens would bring him bread and meat in the morning and evening

q: Why did Elijah have to leave the Brook of Cherith?
why: There was no rain.
quote: Some time later, however, the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land.

q: After the brook dried up, who did God say would provide for Elijah?
why: She lived in Zarephath.
quote: Behold, I have commanded a widow there to provide for you.

q: When Elijah asked for bread, what did the widow of Zarephath have left?
why: She planned a last meal for her son.
quote: only a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug.

q: What happened to the widow's flour and oil after she fed Elijah?
why: God kept His word.
quote: The jar of flour was not exhausted and the jug of oil did not run dry

q: On which mountain did Elijah challenge the prophets of Baal?
why: All Israel gathered there.
quote: Now summon all Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel

q: On Mount Carmel, what did Elijah ask the people?
why: They had to choose between God and Baal.
quote: How long will you waver between two opinions?

q: On Mount Carmel, Elijah said the true God would answer by what?
why: Baal's prophets agreed to the test.
quote: The God who answers by fire, He is God.

q: When Baal's prophets called on Baal all morning, what happened?
why: Baal was not real.
quote: But there was no sound, and no one answered

q: Before praying on Mount Carmel, what did Elijah have poured on the offering?
why: It made the miracle even greater.
quote: Fill four waterpots and pour the water on the offering and on the wood.

q: When Elijah prayed on Mount Carmel, what fell from the LORD?
why: It burned up even the water.
quote: Then the fire of the LORD fell and consumed the sacrifice

q: After the fire fell on Mount Carmel, what did the people shout?
why: They fell facedown.
quote: The LORD, He is God! The LORD, He is God!

q: Which priest anointed Solomon as king?
why: The people shouted, “Long live King Solomon!”
quote: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tabernacle and anointed Solomon.

q: After King David died, who sat on his throne?
why: His kingdom was firmly established.
quote: So Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his kingdom was firmly established.

q: Where did the LORD appear to Solomon in a dream?
why: God offered him any gift.
quote: One night at Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream

q: After Solomon judged the two women's case, what did all Israel see in him?
why: They stood in awe.
quote: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to administer justice.

q: Solomon's understanding was beyond measure, like what on the seashore?
why: God gave him great wisdom.
quote: and understanding beyond measure, like the sand on the seashore.

q: How many proverbs did King Solomon compose?
why: His songs numbered a thousand and five.
quote: Solomon composed three thousand proverbs

q: Why could the priests not minister when Solomon's temple was dedicated?
why: The cloud filled the house.
quote: for the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD.

q: Which queen came to test Solomon with difficult questions?
why: She had heard of his fame.
quote: Now when the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon

q: When Solomon grew old, what turned his heart after other gods?
why: He was not fully devoted like David.
quote: For when Solomon grew old, his wives turned his heart after other gods

q: Which king of Israel did more evil than all before him and opposed Elijah?
why: He was the son of Omri.
quote: However, Ahab son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD, more than all who were before him.

q: When Elijah prayed for the widow's son who had died, what happened?
why: The LORD listened to Elijah.
quote: and the child’s life returned to him, and he lived.

q: On Mount Carmel, what did Elijah say Baal might be doing?
why: He was mocking the false god.
quote: Perhaps he is sleeping and must be awakened!

q: On Mount Carmel, how many stones did Elijah use to build the altar?
why: One for each tribe.
quote: And Elijah took twelve stones, one for each tribe of the sons of Jacob

q: After Carmel, how big was the first cloud Elijah's servant saw rising from the sea?
why: Then heavy rain fell.
quote: There is a cloud as small as a man’s hand rising from the sea.

q: When Elijah fled and slept under a broom tree, who woke him?
why: The angel told him to eat.
quote: Suddenly an angel touched him and said, “Get up and eat.”

q: At the mountain of God, after wind, earthquake, and fire, what came to Elijah?
why: God spoke gently.
quote: And after the fire came a still, small voice.

q: In what year after leaving Egypt did Solomon begin building the temple?
why: It was Solomon's fourth year.
quote: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt

q: How many cubits long, wide, and high was the temple's inner sanctuary?
why: It was a perfect cube of gold.
quote: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and twenty cubits high.

q: Solomon said no one was as skilled in logging as which people?
why: They cut the cedars of Lebanon.
quote: for you know that there are none among us as skilled in logging as the Sidonians.

q: How many songs did King Solomon write?
why: He also wrote 3,000 proverbs.
quote: and his songs numbered a thousand and five.

q: Where was the prophet Elijah from?
why: He is called Elijah the Tishbite.
quote: Now Elijah the Tishbite, who was among the settlers of Gilead

q: By which brook did Elijah hide during the drought?
why: It was east of the Jordan.
quote: hide yourself by the Brook of Cherith, east of the Jordan.

q: In which town did the widow who fed Elijah live?
why: God sent him there.
quote: Get up and go to Zarephath of Sidon, and stay there.

q: How many prophets of Baal faced Elijah on Mount Carmel?
why: Elijah stood alone.
quote: along with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal

q: Under what kind of tree did Elijah sit and pray to die?
why: He was worn out and afraid.
quote: He sat down under a broom tree and prayed that he might die.

q: Strengthened by the angel's food, how long did Elijah walk to Horeb?
why: Horeb is the mountain of God.
quote: he walked forty days and forty nights until he reached Horeb, the mountain of God.

q: In which month was Solomon's temple finished?
why: It was the eighth month.
quote: In his eleventh year and eighth month, the month of Bul, the temple was finished
